svg.title: Tanish Gupta's illustrated ASUS Vivobook developer workspace
svg.desc: Tanish Gupta’s VS Code-style .NET workspace. Six large, centered headings type, pause, erase, and repeat: C# / .NET Developer; Building APIs with purpose.; Connecting backend to frontend.; Learning by building.; Crafting clean C# code.; Building with ASP.NET Core.. Every eight seconds the integrated terminal types dotnet run, then shows Now listening on localhost, holds for several seconds, fades clear, and starts again. The cursor follows each typed character. The physical laptop and surroundings are preserved. Reduced-motion preferences show a complete static heading and terminal.
